Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This experiment is highly specialized as it focuses on proteasome-catalyzed peptide splicing (PCPS). Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail because the peptides are not generated by trypsin but by proteasomes, and many are 'spliced' (non-contiguous fragments of the substrate), requiring a custom search space of all theoretically possible spliced combinations for each synthetic substrate.
